name: marcella mushrooms
instructions:
Marcella's mushroom braise — three ingredients and olive oil.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- MUSHROOMS
- PORCINI MUSHROOM POWDER
- PARSLEY
- OLIVE OIL

=== PROCEDURE ===

Braise the mushrooms in olive oil with the porcini powder; parsley to finish.
notes:
=== SOURCE ===

Marcella Hazan. Not yet cooked from this book — recorded as the designated side for [[bolognese]].

=== THE BOLOGNESE SIDE ===

Born from the bolognese herb question: parsley and mushrooms are both CLASHING in the vegetarian bolognese (variant B), but a porcini powder/mushroom/parsley braise alongside it gets both flavors on the plate — neither needs integration into the sauce.
